goals.name: RIG App Studio mission session (meta process for every web and mobile app build)
goals.description: RIG App Studio mission session (meta process for every web and mobile app build) [app-studio-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/app-studio-session.yaml

gates.name: A1 spec.md exists with a source per feature row and executable
gates.description: spec.md exists with a source per feature row and executable acceptance checks, and JEV app.spec plus plan.readiness cleared (required signals above 0.9) or the transition is DEFERRED
gates.command: spec path plus both decision ids in the mission record

gates.name: A2 stack.md names the lane, applies the build-location matrix,
gates.description: stack.md names the lane, applies the build-location matrix, gives every paid vendor a named fallback, and cleared JEV app.stack

gates.name: A3 app-sandbox-preflight returned no FAIL before the first inst
gates.description: app-sandbox-preflight returned no FAIL before the first install or build; BLOCKED rows are named for Mike
gates.command: preflight table in the mission record

gates.name: A4 every slice ends in an executed check (command and output, r
gates.description: every slice ends in an executed check (command and output, route and status, or screenshot); at most three fix attempts per slice before escalation
gates.command: slice records with per-slice check output (app-slice-loop)

gates.name: A5 every stage transition carries a rig-s1gate app.stage-gate r
gates.description: every stage transition carries a rig-s1gate app.stage-gate receipt with required signals above 0.9; classifier unavailable means DEFER the transition, never guess
gates.command: stage_scores rows with rubric, decision id, and signals

gates.name: A6 every spec screen was captured from the real app and judged
gates.description: every spec screen was captured from the real app and judged by app-ui-judge; DEFERRED rows are named and never counted as passes
gates.command: screen verdict rows with image paths

gates.name: A7 an agent other than the builder re-ran the acceptance checks
gates.description: an agent other than the builder re-ran the acceptance checks; tests contain assertion verbs; one planted failure went RED then GREEN with checksum proof
gates.command: verify.md with verifier identity, assertion counts, and plant checksums

gates.name: A8 run.jsonl carries a receipt for every App Studio lesson whos
gates.description: run.jsonl carries a receipt for every App Studio lesson whose trigger fired, and validate_lessons.py exits 0 on it

gates.name: A9 deploy, push, domain, purchase, and store submission are hel
gates.description: deploy, push, domain, purchase, and store submission are held at Gate-D with an app.ship record; the mission may close HELD
gates.command: held_at_gate field or a Gate-D approval id

gates.name: A10 mission closed: comparison table, new lessons appended and t
gates.description: mission closed: comparison table, new lessons appended and their sub-skills patched, watcher routines deleted, ProofPacket sealed
gates.command: close record with proof hash and lesson ids

preconditions.startup_phrase: I build from gated specs; I do not certify my own work.
preconditions.harness_tuple: H_app(spec, stack, preflight, slices, transitions, screens, verify, lessons, gate_d, close)

quality_criteria: spec.md exists with a source per feature row and executable acceptance checks, and JEV app.spec plus plan.readiness cleared (required signals above 0.9) or the transition is DEFERRED
stack.md names the lane, applies the build-location matrix, gives every paid vendor a named fallback, and cleared JEV app.stack
app-sandbox-preflight returned no FAIL before the first install or build; BLOCKED rows are named for Mike
every slice ends in an executed check (command and output, route and status, or screenshot); at most three fix attempts per slice before escalation
every stage transition carries a rig-s1gate app.stage-gate receipt with required signals above 0.9; classifier unavailable means DEFER the transition, never guess
every spec screen was captured from the real app and judged by app-ui-judge; DEFERRED rows are named and never counted as passes
an agent other than the builder re-ran the acceptance checks; tests contain assertion verbs; one planted failure went RED then GREEN with checksum proof
run.jsonl carries a receipt for every App Studio lesson whose trigger fired, and validate_lessons.py exits 0 on it
deploy, push, domain, purchase, and store submission are held at Gate-D with an app.ship record; the mission may close HELD
mission closed: comparison table, new lessons appended and their sub-skills patched, watcher routines deleted, ProofPacket sealed
anti_patterns: Scaffolding before A1 and A2 hold - that is how invented specs and unbuildable stacks happen
Accepting a slice on prose instead of an executed check
Counting a DEFERRED judge or an uncalibrated ESCALATE as a pass
Letting a watcher routine run builds next to the builder
Filing lessons in memory only and closing the mission
